title: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness - Pre Vocational Studies - Records and Book Keeping
exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Written documents that systematically show the history, daily activities, and financial transactions carried out on a farm are called ________.
questions.explain: Farm records are documented accounts of all operations, purchases, sales, and events that take place on a farm over time.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: What is the most crucial business reason for a farmer to keep accurate farm records?
options: To monitor the farm's progress and determine whether it is making a profit or a loss
To keep the farm labourers busy writing after fieldwork
To show off the farm's wealth to competitors
To increase the physical weight of the farm produce
questions.explain: Records provide factual data that help the farm manager evaluate performance, make future plans, and accurately calculate profit or loss.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: A record book in which a farmer documents all routine daily operations, events, and occurrences on the farm is known as a ________.
questions.explain: A farm diary serves as a day-to-day log of events, observations, and tasks carried out on the farm (such as dates of planting or rainfall).
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which type of farm record provides a comprehensive, itemized list of all the assets, machinery, buildings, and unsold stock owned by the farm at a specific date?
questions.explain: A farm inventory is a listing and valuation of all physical assets (like tractors, land, and tools) belonging to the farm at a given point in time.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: If a farmer purchases 50 bags of fertilizers and 20 packets of seeds for the planting season, in which farm record should these items be documented?
questions.explain: The input record is specifically used to track all the items and materials brought into the farm to facilitate agricultural production, such as seeds, fertilizers, and feeds.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which type of farm record is maintained specifically to document the quantity of crop yield harvested and the number of livestock birthed or raised on the farm?
questions.explain: A production record is used to document the physical output or yield of the farm, such as the number of bags of maize harvested or the quantity of milk collected.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: When a farmer and his family eat some of the yams harvested from the farm, the exact quantity taken for their personal use must be entered into the ________.
questions.explain: A consumption record keeps track of all farm produce consumed by the farmer, his household, or fed to livestock, so that they can be accounted for when calculating the farm's total yield and profit.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: The farm record that shows the details of all agricultural products sold to customers and the exact amount of money received is the ________.
questions.explain: The sales record documents the financial income generated from selling farm produce, showing what was sold, the quantity, and the amount paid by the buyer.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: At the end of an accounting period, which of the following records is prepared specifically to determine the overall financial performance (net financial standing) of the farm business?
questions.explain: The profit and loss account is a summary financial statement prepared at the end of the year to match total revenue against total expenses, revealing whether the farm made a profit or suffered a loss.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: What is a major benefit of using computer-aided farm records over traditional paper record keeping?
options: It increases the physical size of the farm animals
It allows for faster data retrieval, higher accuracy, and easier storage
It eliminates the need for any farm labour
It requires less electrical power than a farm tractor
questions.explain: Computers software (like spreadsheets) make record keeping highly efficient, error-free, and ensure that large volumes of farm data can be stored securely and retrieved instantly.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Book keeping in agriculture is best defined as the ________.
options: Act of reading textbooks about farming
Art of preserving agricultural produce in books
Systematic recording of daily financial transactions of the farm business
Counting of trees in a derived forest
questions.explain: Book keeping is the systematic, chronological recording of day-to-day financial transactions, enabling a business to accurately track its income and expenditure.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: In book keeping, documents that provide the original written evidence that a financial transaction took place are called ________.
questions.explain: Source documents (such as receipts, invoices, and vouchers) are the original physical records used as evidence that a specific transaction occurred.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: A source document sent by a farmer to a customer, detailing the goods supplied on credit and the amount the customer owes, is known as a ________.
questions.explain: A sales invoice is issued by the seller (farmer) to a buyer detailing the goods sold on credit and the total amount due for payment.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: When a farm manager buys livestock feed from a supplier on credit, the document received from the supplier stating the quantity and amount owed is the ________.
questions.explain: A purchase invoice is a document received from a supplier when goods are bought on credit, showing what was purchased and how much the buyer owes.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: If a customer returns a crate of damaged eggs back to the farm, this transaction is recorded in the book keeping system as a ________.
questions.explain: Return inwards (also called sales returns) refers to goods previously sold that are returned to the business by customers due to defects or wrong specifications.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which concept describes the situation where a farmer returns expired fertilizers to the supplier?
questions.explain: Return outwards (or purchase returns) occurs when a business returns defective or incorrect goods back to its suppliers.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: In the preparation of farm accounts, a book of original entry where daily credit transactions are recorded before being posted to the ledger is called a ________.
questions.explain: A journal is a subsidiary book or book of prime entry used to record financial transactions in chronological order before they are transferred (posted) to the ledger accounts.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which journal is specifically used to record the daily credit sales of farm produce?
questions.explain: The sales journal (or sales day book) is used exclusively for recording the daily sales of goods sold to customers on credit.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: A farmer buys tractors and farm implements on credit. In which book of original entry will this primarily be recorded?
questions.explain: The purchase journal (or purchases day book) is used to record all purchases of goods or assets made on credit by the business.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Accurate book keeping can greatly benefit a farmer when attempting to ________.
options: Increase the natural growth rate of crops
Cure infectious viral diseases in animals
questions.explain: Financial institutions require comprehensive, well-kept financial records (book keeping) as proof of a farm's profitability before approving and issuing agricultural loans.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies
